items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only finance posture. Reject new fleet-control, AI-prototype, and content-normalization admissions this cycle; delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, and financial attribution is insufficient for ROI-based prioritization. Preserve existing repair, measurement, readiness, security, and private-launch work. The only supported revenue claim is $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; all $4.92 is unattributed to individual sites. Do not claim site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, revenue lift, or causal impact.

AI spend is measurable but not yet decision-grade for unit economics: September 1-30 records show 5,511 calls, 234 errors, 5 transient errors, and $996.91966025 total AI cost across 39 instrumented sites. The observable AI cost per call is approximately $0.1809, but cost-to-learn and cost per verified outcome are not calculable because AI usage is not joined to request/work-item outcomes and the time windows are not reconciled. Minimum measurement: a dated join key from AI calls/cost to site, role, request or work item, outcome state, and measurement window.

Contribution margin and total budget exposure are unknown. The brief provides AI cost but no infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, payment, or other operating-cost ledger; monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Minimum measurement: authorized read-only monthly cost export by site and shared service, joined to the same dated revenue and AI-cost windows. Until available, use contribution margin = unknown and do not extrapolate the $4.92 commission snapshot.

Retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next slot-gated implementation, but treat it as a measurement experiment rather than a revenue forecast. Its 2026-09-21 baseline is 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Measure registered outbound affiliate clicks after release; conversion, commission, margin, and ROI remain unknown until site-level revenue and cost attribution exist.
